findings.claim: Every issue the PR description leans on — #1085, #1086, #1091, #1093, #1106 — returns "Could not resolve to an issue" in dkropachev/tidepool, making all four deferrals and the Refs: line unverifiable for anyone reviewing the repo.

findings.claim: The PR body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]" and both commits carry a Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) trailer, violating the instruction in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md to never add Claude/Anthropic attribution to anything authored.

findings.claim: A vint length narrowing negative and decoding to empty with a nil error is called out as a deferred issue (#1106), left un-investigated as out of scope for this PR.

findings.claim: Rejecting dim < 1 in the metadata parsers is called out as deferred (#1093), landing separately and not addressed by this PR.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize checked and confirmed to never allow division by zero
findings.claim: The reviewer confirms vectorElemMinSize returns ≥1 on every path, so there is no division-by-zero risk.

findings.title: Saturation guard in bound calculation checked and confirmed not to overflow
findings.claim: The reviewer confirms the saturation guard in the new bound cannot overflow.

findings.title: Nested arithmetic checked against marshalVector/isVectorVariableLengthType wire format
findings.claim: The reviewer confirms the nested arithmetic matches what marshalVector/isVectorVariableLengthType actually put on the wire.

findings.title: Placing the bound before fast paths confirmed to make Dimensions*8/*4 non-wrapping
findings.claim: The reviewer confirms that placing the bound before the fast paths does make Dimensions*8 and Dimensions*4 provably non-wrapping.

findings.title: Nil SubType panic behavior confirmed unchanged/consistent across nesting levels
findings.claim: The reviewer confirms nil SubType still panics only where it panicked before (Dimensions > 0, at every nesting level), so the zero-dimension carve-out is consistent.

findings.title: Marshal-side make([]byte, dim*4) confirmed unreachable with a hostile dim
findings.claim: The reviewer confirms marshal-side make([]byte, dim*4) is unreachable with a hostile dim because the length check precedes it.

findings.title: Test comment's 32-bit-target claim is untestable in this environment
findings.claim: GOARCH=386 cannot be checked because serialization/varint and serialization/cqlint don't compile for 32-bit on main either, making the test comment's claim that the fix "lands on a 32-bit target too" untestable here.

findings.title: TestSSL*/TestShardAwarePort* failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this PR
findings.claim: The four TestSSL*/TestShardAwarePort* failures in the unit suite are due to missing test certs, are present on main, and are unrelated to this PR's changes.
